text:
Type: three-arm chandelier with pleated shades
Use: ambient light over a dining table or in a sitting area; dining room, living room, bedroom
Style: traditional, classic, contemporary
Materials: nickel-plated metal arms, chain and ceiling cup, pleated white fabric shades
Colors: white, silver nickel
Shape: three curved arms rising from a central stem, each topped by a small tapered pleated shade, hangs on a decorative chain, medium size, elegant and balanced
Feel: elegant, soft, homey, gentle
Goes with: white or pastel walls, dark or light wood, brass or silver accents; classic, traditional or farmhouse dining rooms

product.name: RSTID
product.description: The textile shade provides a diffused and decorative light.
